name: knix-wayland

seat_provider.rule: the compositor runs as knix through the guest's own seatd; both wlroots backends must be listed or libinput is never loaded; virtio input devices need a guest-owned seat tag

autostart.fallback: GPU=none leaves the DRM condition unmet; the serial console and ssh remain the full fallback path

fallback: the guest's own systemd target starts the session at boot when the DRM device exists; GPU=none leaves that condition unmet and keeps the serial console and ssh available
